title: unified-rollouts: improve canary/A-B/shadow autorollback heuristics and observability
description:
Motivation: Recent rollouts saw noisy telemetry leading to either noisy false-positive rollbacks or delayed detection of regressions when using canary, A/B and shadow traffic together. This PR tightens autorollback decisioning, adds quorum-based composite metrics, improves probing for staged shadowing, and instruments richer observability for rollback root cause analysis.

What this changes: consolidated autorollback engine enhancements and observability updates implemented across controller, rollout engine, and the telemetry pipeline. High-level changes: 1) CompositeMetric: introduces a composite metric evaluator that can weight latency/error/quality signals and apply a quorum (N of M) to avoid single-metric noise-driven rollbacks. 2) Probing improvements: adds a preflight probing stage with exponential backoff probes and an adaptive probe quorum for staged shadow traffic. 3) Stability guards: introduces minimum observation windows and cooldown windows for canary increments to reduce flapping. 4) Telemetry and traces: emit detailed rollback_decision events, contributing_metric snapshots, and rollout_trace_id for end-to-end tracing. 5) Tests and e2e: adds unit tests for the evaluator and end-to-end integration tests that simulate noisy metrics. 6) Docs: rollout docs and console help updated with examples and recommended config templates.

Risk and mitigation: changes touch rollback decision logic; to reduce blast radius we default new logic behind a feature flag (rollouts.autorollback.v2) and keep legacy behavior for existing clusters. Added additional integration tests in perf-canary and a small canary in staging for rollout validation.

Related: Linear ENG-2214 (composite rollback metrics), ENG-2250 (probing and staged shadow upgrades).

Checklist: 
- [x] Core evaluator implementation
- [x] Telemetry/events and tracing hooks
- [x] Unit tests for composite evaluator
- [x] e2e integration tests in perf-canary
- [x] Docs and console examples
- [x] Feature-flag gating

Testing notes: Local unit test suite passes. Integration test harness (perf-canary stack) included scenarios for flaky latency spikes and simulated model regression; autorollback triggered only when quorum met. Manual staging rollout executed with dark traffic, observed no false-positive rollbacks over 48h.

How to review: focus on autorollback/evaluator.go, rollout_controller.go, telemetry/events.go, perf-canary integration test scenarios, and docs/rollouts/autorollback.md. The feature flag is configurable via operator config and deployment manifests.
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Improved autorollback decisioning: composite metric quorum to reduce noisy rollbacks; preflight probing for staged shadow traffic; additional rollback tracing events and console observability. Backward compatible behind feature flag rollouts.autorollback.v2.
commits: feat(rollouts): add composite metric evaluator and quorum logic
perf(rollout-engine): reduce evaluation tail latency by caching metric snapshots
feat(telemetry): emit rollback_decision and contributing_metric events
docs(rollouts): autorollback examples and config templates
chore: gate changes behind rollouts.autorollback.v2 feature flag
review_thread: Arjun Rao: The composite evaluator looks good, but can we ensure the quorum config is overridable per-tenant?
Maya Chen: Good call — added tenant-level override in operator config and updated docs (defaults remain cluster-wide).
Noah Kim: Tests are comprehensive; can you add one more case where latency spikes are correlated with increased throughput?
Maya Chen: Added e2e scenario in perf-canary to simulate throughput-correlated latency spikes (see perf-canary/tests).
Emilia García: Suggest emitting a rollback_reason field with stable enum values for alerting — makes querying simpler.
Maya Chen: Implemented rollback_reason enum and updated telemetry docs and console mapping.
merge_summary: Squash merged by release-manager after approvals and green CI. Kept feature-flag disabled by default; follow-up runbook added for staged enablement in staging then production.
notes: Operator-ops to coordinate canary enablement window. Observability team: dashboards updated and an alert template for composite quorum breaches was added.
